resources.string: A live wallpaper for the home and lock screens. It ticks every second while the screen is on. In the picker you can choose home, lock, or both.
Tap the clock to hide these settings.
Hours and minutes. Android widgets update once a minute, so there\'s no seconds row. The same widget works on the lock screen widget page.
The full clock with seconds while charging. Choose \u201cBinary clock\u201d in the screen saver settings.
Long-press your home screen, tap Widgets, and find Binary Clock.
The full-screen clock you see when you open this app.
Home screen and lock screen widget. Hours and minutes only, since Android widgets update once a minute.
Live wallpaper behind your home screen. Also used when one wallpaper is applied to home and lock together.
Live wallpaper on the lock screen. To use these settings, apply the wallpaper to the lock screen only; the clock sits below the system clock.
The screen saver shown while charging. Always dark.
